Goal margins

Home-team scoring margin distribution

Positive values indicate a home win, zero a draw, and negative values an away win. The histogram bins are built from each match’s recorded score.

The shape is a league-wide distribution; filters below let you inspect the underlying match records.

High-scoring matches

Five or more goals, by season

Bars show the observed share of matches with at least five combined goals. The line uses a second axis for the season mean total goals.

Both metrics use the same season match rows and update only from recorded final scores.

Season-by-season team output

Choose any club to display its home and away goals per appearance. Dashed lines indicate away fixtures.

All figures are computed from the checked-in match-level CSV. Paired xG is available only where both values are present; missing xG is never imputed. Descriptive patterns are not causal estimates. The table displays up to 100 matching rows at a time; it does not sample or alter the underlying CSV.
